canonical_data: in-process agent graph state for each run; the README documents no durable store
current_repo_note: Controls mobile devices rather than a browser; the closest role is the computer-use agent role.
strengths: Operates a real Android phone or emulator, or an iOS simulator, on the UI tree the device exposes
Can return structured JSON from what it finds in an app, described in natural language, and runs against OpenAI, Google, xAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or MiniMax models
A published paper describes the multi-agent task decomposition behind the AndroidWorld result
weaknesses: The 100 percent AndroidWorld figure is the maintainers' own claim; the README also says games are poorly handled because they expose no accessibility tree
Physical iOS devices are not supported, and the Docker quick launch works for Android only
No approval step is documented before the agent acts inside real apps on a real device
why_it_matters: One of few open agents that acts on real phones, with a documented multi-agent decomposition behind a leading mobile benchmark claim.
